description: This file implements a Redis cache service with methods for setting, getting, incrementing, decrementing, removing, and scanning cache entries, including serialization and metrics collection.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A Redis cache client with methods for cache operations including set, get, increment, decrement, remove, and scan.

methods.name: NewRedis
methods.description: Creates a new Redis cache instance with specified options and client.

methods.name: Purge
methods.description: Clears the cache by scanning and removing all entries.

methods.name: SetWithDefaultExpiry
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair with default expiry.

methods.name: SetWithExpiry
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair with specified expiry.

methods.name: Increment
methods.description: Increments the numeric value of a key.

methods.name: Decrement
methods.description: Decrements the numeric value of a key.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes the value for a given key.

methods.name: GetMulti
methods.description: Fetches multiple keys in a single operation.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Deletes a key from the cache.

methods.name: RemoveMulti
methods.description: Deletes multiple keys from the cache.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Scans cache keys matching a pattern and applies a function to the results.

methods.name: GetInvalidateClusterEvent
methods.description: Returns the cluster event associated with cache invalidation.
